notes.title: Release Date Update for Infinite Void
notes.content:
Dear Players,

After thorough deliberation and extensive discussions with our community on Discord, we have made a difficult but necessary decision regarding the release of Infinite Void. We are postponing the game's launch to December to ensure it has the best possible chance for success.

The game's Steam page was initially scheduled to go live in January of this year. However, due to unforeseen circumstances, we experienced delays. Consequently, this new release date will allow Infinite Void to receive the full six-month preparation period on Steam that we initially intended.

We deeply appreciate your understanding and continued support. Please know that this decision was not made lightly, and we are committed to delivering the best gaming experience possible.

Thank you for your patience and trust.

Sincerely,

The Infinite Void Development Team
